These features are classic hallmarks of glioblastoma, which is the archetypal IDH-wildtype tumor. IDH-mutant gliomas typically present with non-enhancing or, at most, faint, wispy enhancement and rarely show necrosis. The deep insular and basal ganglia location is less specific but is a common site for IDH-wildtype tumors. There are no imaging features that would suggest an IDH-mutant status.
